::: {.press-note}
**Press enquiries.** I am happy to comment on the following issues:
<ul style="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0;">
<li>the state of international cooperation and global governance;</li>
<li>the challenges of social protection and the green transition, especially their global dimensions;</li>
<li>developments within major international organizations, especially the European Union, the United Nations, the International Monetary Fund, and the World Health Organization.</li>
</ul>
Over the years, I have been interviewed by major global media outlets, including <em>The New York Times</em>, <em>The Economist</em>, BBC, the Associated Press, and Reuters. 

Email [alexandros.kentikelenis@unibocconi.it](mailto:alexandros.kentikelenis@unibocconi.it); for urgent requests, call +39 371 5350 186.
